Title: Tonotopic changes in 2-deoxyglucose activity in chick cochlear nucleus during hair cell loss and regeneration.

Notes: Animal only (chicks, gentamicin hair cell loss/regeneration). No acoustic stimulus condition stated.

Title: Age-related sensitivity to cisplatin ototoxicity in gerbils.

Notes: Animal only (gerbils, postnatal P10-P42). DPOAE measured but no stimulus frequency/level values stated in abstract.

Title: Cisplatin ototoxicity in developing gerbils.
Evidence_Quote: investigate the dose-related effect of cisplatin exposure in young gerbils (2 weeks of age)
Notes: Animal only (young gerbils). Frequency-specific results stated (frequencies below 8 kHz), DPOAE/ABR thresholds.

Title: Mechano-electrical transduction in mice lacking the alpha-subunit of the epithelial sodium channel.

Notes: Animal only (neonatal knockout mice, cochlear cultures). Hair bundles mechanically stimulated by fluid jet; no acoustic condition stated.

Title: Determination of hair cell degeneration and hair cell death in neomycin treated cultures of the neonatal rat cochlea.

Notes: Animal only (neonatal rat cochlea cultures). Hair cell death assay, no acoustic condition.

Title: Evidence for loss and recovery of chick brainstem auditory neurons during gentamicin-induced cochlear damage and regeneration.
Evidence_Quote: Chicks were given a single systemic dose of gentamicin
Notes: Animal only (chicks). Neuron counts after gentamicin damage; acoustic overstimulation appears only as background, no acoustic condition in this study.

Title: Temporary threshold shifts induced by low-pass and high-pass filtered noises in fetal sheep in utero.
Evidence_Quote: Auditory brainstem responses (ABRs) were obtained from nine late gestational age fetal sheep in utero
Notes: Animal only: subjects are fetal sheep, not human fetuses. Rich acoustic conditions: filtered noises approx. 120 dB SPL, cut-off 1.0 kHz, tone bursts 0.5/1.0/2.0 kHz.

Title: Action potentials and underlying voltage-dependent currents studied in cultured spiral ganglion neurons of the postnatal gerbil.

Notes: AMBIGUOUS: Hz values in abstract are electrical current-pulse rates (e.g. 50 Hz trains), not acoustic stimuli; judged no acoustic condition. Animal only (gerbil neurons).

Title: Anatomy of the normal human cochlear aqueduct with functional implications.

Notes: AMBIGUOUS: human temporal-bone anatomy study spanning all ages; stratum A because specimens aged 0-1 years are included as subjects. Acoustic model values stated (frequencies above 20 Hz, below 150 Hz).

Title: Sensitive developmental periods for kanamycin ototoxic effects on distortion-product otoacoustic emissions.
Evidence_Quote: assess functional effects of administering a regimen of kanamycin to three groups of neonatal rats
Notes: Animal only (neonatal rats). DPOAE input-output functions measured but no stimulus frequency/level values stated in abstract.

Title: Thyroxine affects physiological and morphological development of the ear.
Evidence_Quote: The onset and development of distortion product otoacoustic emissions (DPE) representing cochlear amplifier activity were studied in neonatal hyperthyroid (n = 10) and control (n = 10) rat pups
Notes: Animal only (neonatal rat pups). Acoustic values stated: DPE at 8 kHz and 3 kHz, stimulus intensities 70 dB SPL and 50 dB SPL, clicks.

Title: Auditory brainstem responses of CBA/J mice with neonatal conductive hearing losses and treatment with GM1 ganglioside.
Evidence_Quote: Exogenous administration of GM1 ganglioside to CBA/J mice with a neonatal conductive hearing loss
Notes: Animal only (neonatal CBA/J mice). ABR thresholds compared (greatest decreases at high frequencies) but no stimulus frequency/level values stated.

Title: Consequences of chronic extracochlear electrical stimulation in neonatally deafened cats.
Evidence_Quote: Cats were bilaterally deafened by daily ototoxic drug administration for two weeks after birth.

Title: Noise induced hearing loss in fetal sheep.
Evidence_Quote: The auditory brainstem response (ABR) was recorded in utero from chronically instrumented fetal sheep
Notes: Animal fetus only (fetal sheep); human fetus not a subject. Broadband noise 120 dB SPL, tone bursts 0.5-4 kHz.

Title: Development of hearing in neonatal rats: air and bone conducted ABR thresholds.
Evidence_Quote: the ABR to both air conducted (AC) and bone-conducted (BC) auditory stimulation was determined in neonatal rats

Title: Thyroid hormone induces earlier onset of auditory function in neonatal rats.
Evidence_Quote: Neonatal rats were injected with thyroxine (T4), or with saline (control animals), from day of birth (post-natal day-PND-0)
Notes: Subjects are neonatal rats only. ABR thresholds measured but no sound type, dB, Hz, or BPM stated in abstract.

Title: The sensitivity to 3,3'-iminodipropionitrile differs for high- and midfrequency hearing loss in the developing rat.
Evidence_Quote: Primiparous Long Evans rats or their offspring were exposed to either saline or 300 mg/kg IDPN for three consecutive days.

Title: Activity patterns of primary auditory-nerve fibres in chickens: development of fundamental properties.

Title: Hypoxia induced hearing loss in animal models of the fetus in-utero.

Notes: Animal models only (adult cats, adult rats, neonatal guinea pigs and goats); human fetus discussed only as background hypothesis. No sound type/dB/Hz stated.

Title: Pure-tone overstimulation protects surviving avian hair cells from acoustic trauma.
Evidence_Quote: Chicks were exposed to a pure-tone of 1.5 kHz at 124 dB SPL.

Title: Postnatal development of 2f1-f2 otoacoustic emissions in pigmented rat.
Evidence_Quote: Distortion-product emissions at 2f1-f2 were measured in developing, pigmented rats

Title: Perinatal hypoxia and auditory brainstem response thresholds: no evidence of permanent hearing loss.
Evidence_Quote: in neonatal rats exposed to pure nitrogen for several minutes; in neonatal and adult cats respirated with hypoxic gas mixture for an hour

Title: Morphological and electrophysiological study of the inner ear and the central auditory pathways following whole body fetal irradiation.

Title: Changes in middle-ear input admittance during postnatal auditory development in chicks.
Evidence_Quote: Admittance at the tympanic membrane was measured in one ear of 73 chicks in 8 age groups between 1 and 150 days post-hatch.

Title: Age-dependent effects of a pure tone trauma in the chick basilar papilla: evidence for a development of the tonotopic organization.

Title: Maturational and degenerative processes in the organ of Corti after neonatal hypothyroidism.

Notes: Animal subjects only (rats). Elevated auditory thresholds around 60-70 dB SPL stated.

Title: The Music Engagement Scale: An Instrument to Measure Engagement in Music Making.

Title: A Systematic Review of Music Interventions to Support Parent-Child Attachment.
Evidence_Quote: typically developing children aged birth to 5 years old and their parents

Title: Parents' Perspectives on Their Child's Music Therapy: A Qualitative Study.

Title: The effectiveness of a short-term group music therapy intervention for parents who have a child with a disability.

Title: The effect of gender on one-day-old infants' behavior and heart rate responses to music decibel level.

Title: Gender differences among newborns on a transient otoacoustic emissions test for hearing.
